---
title: "About this space"
---

Milestone 4 is a Quarto website starter: simple source files, a responsive layout, and enough character to make the project feel like its own place.

## What lives here

- Short project notes and observations
- Small experiments worth revisiting
- Decisions, references, and next steps

The site is intentionally easy to extend. Add a `.qmd` page, link it from the navbar, and render with Quarto.
